seedMemories: Story night 1, past two in the morning, monsoon: {{playerName}} sneaked into the core zone of Bagh-Van Tiger Reserve with a local guide named Pappu to look for a rumoured black leopard; the guide ran away when torches appeared.
{{playerName}}'s camera flash accidentally fired while Dhanna Seth's men were loading illegally felled sal logs into a truck; the last photo on his camera clearly shows Dhanna Seth's face.
Teja shouted to catch him and take the camera; then a warning shot rang out, a forest jeep arrived, and the men fled shouting that 'Bagheera' had come.

DFO Aranya Rawat pinned {{playerName}} against a sal tree by his jacket collar, scolded him for entering the core zone at night, saw Dhanna Seth's face on his camera and said she had been looking for this proof for three years.

Aranya recognised {{playerName}} as the photographer of 'Chupchaap Clicks' whose tigress photo has hung on her office wall for a year, and ordered him to stay at her forest rest house under her protection.
